values.name: between

values.name: auto
values.prose: Specifies an auto repeaterInfo about the 'auto repeater' reference.#auto-repeaterReferenced in:4.5. Lists of values and the repeat() notation (2) 4.6. Assigning gap decoration values to gaps (2) (3) (4) (5) 4.7. Interpolation of list values (2) (3) (4) (5) 4.8. Serialization Possible linking syntaxes:[=auto repeater=][=/auto repeater=]. An auto repeater will be used to fill in values for gaps that would not otherwise receive values from other parts of the list. At most one repeat() in a given list of values may be an auto repeater. Continuing from the previous example, if the author does not know how many columns will be in the final layout, they might instead write: column-rule-color: gray, repeat(auto, red, blue), gray; Which will produce a gray decoration in the first and last column gaps, and alternating red and blue decorations in the in-between column gaps.
